page0.text:
...
I'm sure I'll regret it if I keep lying to myself, even if I keep going.

page1.text:
Where responsibility lies. Good and evil.
The thought of losing Sakura weighs heavier on me than any of those concerns.
...It's not even about making up my mind.
I just want to protect Sakura.

page2.text:
"...Yeah. It's just natural to protect the girl I love. Even I know that."
"Right? And I'll be on your side because that's how you are."

page3.text:
Illya laughs happily.
...
Her innocence gives me courage.
...I don't know if this choice is wrong or not.
But I'm sure I won't regret it.

page4.text:
"Sorry, Illya. I need to go."
"Yeah. I'll forgive you, because you're making a face like that. See you next time, Shirou."
"Yeah. Bye, Illya. And thanks."

page5.text:
I leave the park.
Shaking off my doubts, I run to the church.

page6.text:
...
...I've decided on my answer.
I don't know how much Sakura has supported me since my old man died.

page7.text:
I've always thought of her as my kouhai, and tried not to see her as a member of the opposite sex.
I kept lying to myself because I wanted her to stay by my side.
But this isn't a situation I can lie my way through anymore.

page8.text:
Shirou Emiya doesn't want to lose Sakura Matou.
That's all.
If I can't think of anything, then I can just trust in my one, sure feeling.

page9.text:
Even so, in the depths of my mind...
"If you try to protect a single person..."
I can't shake off Archer's prophetic words, no matter how hard I try.

page10.text:
It begins to rain.
The winter rain mercilessly pelts me as I run.
